name: Band Monster Walk
steps: Place a mini resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic quarter-squat position with your knees bent and chest up.
Step forward and outward at a 45 degree angle with your right foot, maintaining tension on the band.
Follow by stepping forward and outward with your left foot in a wide, diagonal zig-zag pattern.
Continue stepping forward for the prescribed distance or repetitions, then reverse backwards using the same diagonal path.
coaching_cues: Never allow your knees to cave inward; push knees actively outward against the band.
Maintain a steady quarter-squat depth throughout the entire walk.
Keep your feet wide enough that tension is maintained on the band at all times.
